name: Washed
description: Fruit is removed before drying, usually followed by fermentation and washing.

name: Natural
description: Whole coffee cherries are dried before the fruit is removed.

name: Honey
description: Some or all mucilage remains on the seed while it dries.

name: Anaerobic
description: Coffee is fermented in a low-oxygen or sealed environment.

name: Wet hulled
description: Coffee is hulled at high moisture before final drying.

name: Carbonic maceration
description: Whole cherries ferment in a carbon-dioxide-rich environment.

name: Other processing
description: A documented process that does not fit another taxonomy entry.
